parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: This is the flush button of the toilet, typically made of durable plastic and located on the top of the tank.
parts.Functional_description: It activates the flushing mechanism, releasing water from the tank into the bowl to clean it.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of the toilet seat, made of plastic and hinged to the seat for covering the bowl.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the toilet bowl to maintain hygiene and can be lifted or closed as needed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the hinge axis to open or close.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the toilet, made of ceramic, supporting the seat and containing the water passage system.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support, holds water, and channels waste to the drainage system.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part anchored to the floor.
